action: 12 bounded low-pass-filtered LEG JOINT residuals; v1 actor frozen, explicit static-load balance + nominal low crawl controller
training_geometry: physical horizontal rail plus posts; clearance varies relative to locked-arm robot top, opening 95-130cm, thickness 7-16cm
qualification: crouch >=4cm, witnessed passage BELOW rail inside posts, whole robot clears, recover normal height and stable >=1s, no rail collision
scope: privileged geometry simulation; down means crawl/crouch under rail, NOT platform descent, hardware, vision, or shared-world chain
warm_start: v1 seed701 actor frozen, not copied into new residual actor
style: crouch before movement, short low movement gate, full upright-start rail passage still requires original strict small-step acceptance
initialization: zero residual actor, fresh critic/optimizer; v1 seed701 actor only used as frozen reference
stage_gate: minimum1M steps and >=75% of32 heldout partial-goal episodes; low-reset25cm goal is NOT under-rail task completion
